name: Animalism — 2 Intermediate — Enhance the Wild Ride

system.description:
A closely guarded Gangrel secret and an enhanced form of Ride the Wild Mind. The vampire's body lies in a motionless trance akin to torpor while her mind possesses an animal so completely that the animal's body begins to take on some of the vampire's own supernatural characteristics.

System: The player spends a Blood Trait and makes a Charisma + Animal Ken Test as for Ride the Wild Mind, but the bond is far deeper: no Willpower expenditure is needed to force the animal against its instincts, and with five or more successes the vampire may spend Blood Traits from the animal's own pool to enhance its physical Traits (the animal dies instantly if this reduces it below half its blood pool, though the vampire's mind remains in control of the corpse). Success level also grants access to other Disciplines through the animal's body: one success allows Auspex or Presence; two, Dominate, Dementation or Animalism; three, Thaumaturgy, Chimerstry or Fortitude; four, Protean or Potence; five, Celerity or spending blood to enhance Traits.

Riding an animal this deeply leaves a lingering residue of its instincts on the vampire's psyche after the link breaks; this should be roleplayed and fades only slowly, though spending eight temporary Willpower points speeds the recovery. If the possessed animal dies or undergoes violent excitement, the player must succeed at a Wits + Empathy Test (three-again) or the vampire's mind snaps back into her own body believing herself to be the animal; a botch instead triggers immediate frenzy. Using this power during the day requires the normal test to stay awake.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
system.bloodCost: 1, plus additional Blood Traits from the animal's pool
